title: Measuring Stability Beyond Accuracy in Small Open-Source Medical Large Language Models for Pediatric Endocrinology

bias_targets.methodology: Asking the LLM to act as a judge and select the most clinically correct reasoning between its own previously generated explanation and a gold-standard explanation provided by medical experts.

Prompting the model with two candidate explanations in both possible orders (e.g., gold-standard first then model-generated, and vice versa) to evaluate if its preference is dependent on the sequence of the options.

Comparing model accuracy, consistency, and response distribution on multiple-choice questions with standard option letters (A-E) versus when the letters are omitted, as well as tracking baseline tendencies to disproportionately guess specific options (e.g., option A).
